question.problem:
Suppose we wish to find a critical point of the function $f(x,y)$ in the region $[0,1]\times [0,1]⊆{R}^{2},$ where $$ f(x,y)=5{x}^{2}y-2{x}^{2}+2x{y}^{2}+3xy-2. $$ Calculate one iteration of the Newton-Raphson process for optimization that starts at ${x}_{0}=[0,\,1]^{T}.$ Round your final answer to **three decimal places.**
${x}_{1}≈[$ {{field-1}} $]$
{{field-2}}
question.worked_solution:
The Newton-Raphson method of optimizing a multivariable function $f:{R}^{n}\to R$ is

$$
{x}_{n+1}={x}_{n}-[{H}_{f}({x}_{n})]^{-1}∇f({x}_{n}),
$$

where $H({x}_{n})$ and $∇f({x}_{n})$ are the Hessian and gradient of $f$, respectively, evaluated at ${x}_{n}.$

In our case, the gradient is

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f(x) & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂x}(5{x}^{2}y-2{x}^{2}+2x{y}^{2}+3xy-2) \\ \frac{∂}{∂y}(5{x}^{2}y-2{x}^{2}+2x{y}^{2}+3xy-2)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}10xy-4x+2{y}^{2}+3y \\ 5{x}^{2}+4xy+3x\end{aligned}],\end{aligned}
$$

and the Hessian is

$$
\begin{aligned}{H}_{f}(x) & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂x}(10xy-4x+2{y}^{2}+3y) & \frac{∂}{∂x}(5{x}^{2}+4xy+3x) \\ \frac{∂}{∂y}(10xy-4x+2{y}^{2}+3y) & \frac{∂}{∂y}(5{x}^{2}+4xy+3x)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}10y-4 & 10x+4y+3 \\ 10x+4y+3 & 4x\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our Newton-Raphson formula is

$$
{x}_{n+1}={x}_{n}-{[\begin{aligned}10y-4 & 10x+4y+3 \\ 10x+4y+3 & 4x\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{n}}^{-1}{[\begin{aligned}10xy-4x+2{y}^{2}+3y \\ 5{x}^{2}+4xy+3x\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{n}}.
$$

Starting with
${x}_{0}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}],$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & ={x}_{0}-{[\begin{aligned}10y-4 & 10x+4y+3 \\ 10x+4y+3 & 4x\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{0}}^{-1}{[\begin{aligned}10xy-4x+2{y}^{2}+3y \\ 5{x}^{2}+4xy+3x\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{0}} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]-{[\begin{aligned}10(1)-4 & 10(0)+4(1)+3 \\ 10(0)+4(1)+3 & 4(0)\end{aligned}]}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}10(0)(1)-4(0)+2(1)^{2}+3(1) \\ 5(0)^{2}+4(0)(1)+3(0)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]-{[\begin{aligned}6 & 7 \\ 7 & 0\end{aligned}]}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]-\frac{1}{6\cdot 0-7\cdot 7}[\begin{aligned}0 & -7 \\ -7 & 6\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}5 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+\frac{1}{49}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -35\end{aligned}] \\  & ≈[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0.286\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
